get.summary: List Resources in one exact Network scope

get.summary: Read one Resource from an exact Network scope

post.summary: Preview the exact impact of replacing a Device target

200.description: Deterministic impact evidence for the current Resource version.

post.summary: Replace a Device target using an exact acknowledged impact preview

200.description: The target replacement committed, or its identical result was replayed.

post.summary: Preview an owner transfer or custodian delegation
post.description: Computes deterministic before/after authority evidence. The authenticated Principal must be the current owner. This read-like preview rejects Idempotency-Key.

200.description: Deterministic authority-change impact bound to the current Resource version.

post.summary: Propose a protected Resource authority change
post.description: Requires a fresh, single-use step-up Account Session from the current owner and exact acknowledged impact evidence. Creates a ten-minute pending request for the target Principal.

202.description: The pending authority-change request was created, or the identical committed proposal was replayed.

post.summary: Confirm and atomically apply a pending Resource authority change
post.description: Requires a distinct fresh, single-use step-up Account Session from the proposed owner or custodian. If-Match identifies the pending request version, not the Resource version.

200.description: The protected Resource authority change committed, or the identical result was replayed.

post.summary: Suspend, resume, or terminally delete one Resource

200.description: The lifecycle transition committed, or its identical result was replayed.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: One strong quoted decimal Device version. Wildcard and weak validators are forbidden.

PolicyIfMatch.name: If-Match
PolicyIfMatch.description: One strong quoted decimal active Policy revision. Wildcard and weak validators are forbidden.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A caller-generated opaque key. Core retains only a versioned HMAC digest.

ResourceIfMatch.name: If-Match
ResourceIfMatch.description: One strong quoted decimal Resource inventory revision.

ResourceGroupIfMatch.name: If-Match
ResourceGroupIfMatch.description: One strong quoted decimal Resource Group collection revision.

AggregateIfMatch.name: If-Match
AggregateIfMatch.description: One strong quoted decimal Resource or Resource Group aggregate version.

AuthorityChangeRequestIfMatch.name: If-Match
AuthorityChangeRequestIfMatch.description: One strong quoted decimal pending authority-change request version. It is not the subject aggregate version.

PageToken.name: page_token
PageToken.description: Opaque continuation token pinned to the collection revision and filter.

DeviceETag.description: The strong quoted decimal terminal Device version.

PolicyETag.description: The strong quoted decimal active Policy revision.

ResourceETag.description: The strong quoted decimal Resource version.

ResourceCollectionETag.description: The strong quoted decimal Resource inventory revision.

ResourceGroupETag.description: The strong quoted decimal Resource Group version.

ResourceGroupLocation.description: The canonical exact-scope Resource Group path.

ResourceGroupCollectionETag.description: The strong quoted decimal Resource Group collection revision.

AuthorityChangeRequestETag.description: The strong quoted decimal pending authority-change request version.

CorrelationID.description: A server-generated UUIDv7 used to correlate the safe response and operational log.

RateLimitLimit.description: The burst capacity for the limiter that made the decision.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Tokens immediately available after the decision.

RateLimitReset.description: Whole seconds until one request can be admitted.

RetryAfter.description: Whole seconds before the caller should retry.

Unauthenticated.description: Missing, malformed, expired, revoked, or stale Account Session.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated principal lacks current exact-scope authority.

NotFound.description: The target is unavailable in the authorized scope.

MethodNotAllowed.description: The resource exists but does not accept this request method.

Conflict.description: Idempotency intent conflict or incompatible terminal state.

Gone.description: The pending protected-change confirmation window expired.

PreconditionFailed.description: The strong mutation version or revision precondition is stale.

UnprocessableEntity.description: The bounded impact set exceeds this API contract.

RateLimited.description: The source or authenticated Account Session exhausted its distributed request budget.

Unavailable.description: Authoritative dependencies, distributed request admission, or bounded process capacity are unavailable.

Timeout.description: The bounded server-side operation deadline expired.
